tasks.label: Build C (Professional Structure)
args: if (!(Test-Path obj)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path obj }; if (!(Test-Path bin/Debug)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path bin/Debug }; & 'C:/msys64/ucrt64/bin/clang.exe' -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wconversion -O2 -c '${file}' -o obj/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.o; & 'C:/msys64/ucrt64/bin/clang.exe' obj/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.o -o bin/Debug/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe

tasks.label: Build C++ (Professional Structure)
args: if (!(Test-Path obj)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path obj }; if (!(Test-Path bin/Debug)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path bin/Debug }; & 'C:/msys64/ucrt64/bin/clang++.exe' -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wconversion -O2 -c '${file}' -o obj/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.o; & 'C:/msys64/ucrt64/bin/clang++.exe' obj/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.o -o bin/Debug/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe
